description:
intent=i034 snapshot=s03 branch=caller-pointer-across-helper status=complete
finding location=net/mac80211/rx.c:3321-3336 confidence=medium conclusion=ieee80211_rx_h_data saves tf from rx->skb->data (rx.c:3324), pskb_may_pull at 3326-3327 can free/move the head on a non-linear TDLS RX frame, and the stale tf->payload_type/category/action_code reads at 3328-3330 give a remote stale-pointer (slab-UAF) read; medium confidence.
unresolved location=net/netfilter/nf_flow_table_ip.c:256 conclusion=Follow up: read net/netfilter/nf_flow_table_ip.c lines 216-283 to confirm iph (= ip_hdr(skb)) is saved before the pskb_may_pull at 256 and its fields are read afterwards without refetch, which would make it the same stale-pointer UAF read as the s05 analogue.
coverage_gap=The two-level caller expansion of pskb_may_pull/pskb_pull/skb_cow/pskb_expand_head/skb_linearize/NF_HOOK call sites across net/ and drivers/net/ was not completed; the finalize order limited reading to net/mac80211/rx.c, net/netfilter/nf_flow_table_ip.c and net/ipv6/mcast.c.
coverage_gap=Per-protocol skb control-block structs (*_skb_cb with pointer- or offset-typed fields, e.g. DN_CB/IPCB analogues) were not enumerated in s03, so cb-stored stale offsets converted against a moved skb->data remain unsearched in this snapshot.
coverage_gap=drivers/net/vxlan.c does not exist at that path in s03 (the driver lives under drivers/net/vxlan/ in this tree), so the vxlan_rcv pskb_may_pull candidate from prior facts was never opened here.
coverage_gap=Other s03 candidates named in prior fact cards (net/x25/x25_in.c, net/decnet absent in s03, sfc ptp match pointer, OVS parse_vlan, seg6_local) were not read in this session and remain unclassified.
coverage_gap=No per-driver audit or KASAN build proved that a non-linear (frag-backed) skb actually reaches ieee80211_rx_h_data; non-linearity was assessed structurally.
limitation=The finding is a source-reading hypothesis, not a reproduction: no KASAN build, crafted TDLS frame or running wifi device was used, and the head reallocation is inferred from pskb_may_pull -> __pskb_pull_tail -> pskb_expand_head semantics rather than observed.
limitation=Triggering requires a non-linear skb at ieee80211_rx_h_data (scatter-gather RX driver); on a linear skb the pull is a no-op and tf stays valid, and unlike the seed the pull length is a compile-time constant rather than an attacker-chosen header field, so only the stale-pointer-into-skb-head mechanism matches.
limitation=The stale tf reads sit in the same boolean expression as the pull; the judgement rests on C && evaluation order (pull evaluated first) and on the compiler having to reload through tf, not on inspected generated code.
limitation=Snapshot revision is opaque (no git history, no network); line numbers are valid only for snapshots/s03 as supplied, and net/phonet/pep.c pep_get_sb (the seed, present in this tree) was excluded from reporting per assignment rules.
